## 页间 v0.1.22

- **Android 六语界面**。首次打开时选择简体中文、हिंदी、Português、Indonesian、English 或 Türkçe，之后可在「设置 → 界面语言」切换。书架、阅读菜单和设置页随之更新。
- **网页版阅读器**。可在 [页间官网](https://itcwc.github.io/yejian-reader/) 选择白纸、护眼或夜读主题，然后打开网页版导入书籍。

### 下载与升级

- **Android** — `yejian-v0.1.22-android.apk`，适用于兼容的 32 位和 64 位设备。已安装 v0.1.21 正式版可直接覆盖升级。旧调试版请先导出备份，再卸载旧版、安装新版并导入备份。[查看迁移步骤](https://github.com/itcwc/yejian-reader/releases/tag/v0.1.21)
- **Windows** — `yejian-v0.1.22-windows-x64.exe`，安装向导提供六种语言。

### English

Choose one of six languages when you first open the Android app, or change it later in **Settings → App language**. The library, reading menus and settings follow your choice. The universal Android APK uses the same release signature as v0.1.21 and supports in-place updates from that version. Windows remains x64.
